source.notes: Two parallel rack wings with a bare-ground corridor, draped aluminet and stepped platforms inside the wings. Dense midseason c6730/c6735/c6727 footage replaces the invented front staircase. This seasonal composite includes later MARS letters; hidden rooms and exact terrace heights remain fitted.
limitations: Rack bays set to nominal 12 ft. Photographic placement is approximate; this is not a measured inventory or survey.

bands.note: low prisms = geometry within the ground body band; .up = above it (overhead). No walkable decks/stairs: none are declared by the procedural scene.
